reviews.text: I am a multi-family interior designer, and I have used Decoscape for years on my projects for outdoor furniture and custom shade structures. Adding photos of a resort style installation of a new apartment complex in Southern Cal and my recent home furniture they produced.

We truly appreciate your support and look forward to many more successful collaborations!

reviews.text: I used Decoscape for a client project, and they were absolutely thrilled with their furniture. reviews.author: Customer
reviews.text:
I recently worked with DecoScape and could not be happier with the entire experience. The quality of the outdoor furniture exceeded my expectations — every piece feels incredibly well made, durable, and beautifully designed. You can immediately tell that a lot of attention goes into both the craftsmanship and the overall aesthetic. The designs are modern, elegant, and completely transformed our outdoor space into something that looks straight out of a luxury resort.

What truly made the experience exceptional, though, was Candice McCarthy. She is hands down the best account manager in the business. From the very beginning, Candice was responsive, knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in helping us find the perfect solutions for our project. She made the entire process seamless and stress-free, always communicating clearly and going above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect.

It’s rare to find a company that delivers both outstanding products and outstanding customer service, but DecoScape absolutely does both. Highly recommend to anyone looking for premium outdoor furniture and a team that truly cares about their customers.
reviews.owner_response: Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed review! We're thrilled to hear you're enjoying your new outdoor furniture and that it transformed your outdoor space exactly as you envisioned. We're especially grateful for your kind words about Candice—she truly cares about helping every customer find the perfect solution. Your recommendation means a great deal to our entire team, and we look forward to serving you again on future outdoor projects!

reviews.author: Ana Simone
reviews.text: I’m an interior designer and recently worked with DecoScape LLC on a luxury outdoor hospitality project in Miami, and the experience was exceptional from start to finish. Their team was professional, responsive, and incredibly detail-oriented throughout the entire process. The quality of the outdoor furniture exceeded my expectations — beautiful craftsmanship, durable materials, and elegant modern designs that completely elevated the space. Delivery times were impressive, communication was seamless, and they were very accommodating with customization requests. It’s rare to find a company that combines high-end design with such outstanding customer service. I highly recommend DecoScape for any residential or commercial outdoor project.
reviews.owner_response: Thank you, Ana, for taking the time to share such a thoughtful review! It was a pleasure collaborating with you on your luxury outdoor hospitality project. We're thrilled that our team, craftsmanship, customization options, and service exceeded your expectations. At DecoScape, we're committed to delivering premium outdoor furniture that combines modern design, durability, and exceptional customer service. Your recommendation means the world to us, and we look forward to partnering with you on many more residential and commercial outdoor projects in the future!

reviews.author: 904 Hospitality
reviews.text:
As a Design & Project Manager, finding vendors that combine aesthetics, quality, and reliability is critical — and DecoScape has consistently delivered on all three. Their product line offers a strong balance of commercial durability and elevated design, which makes specifying for hospitality and outdoor environments much easier.

What has impressed me most is their responsiveness throughout the process. From finish selections and custom options to production updates and delivery coordination, the communication has been proactive and professional. The quality of the furniture exceeded expectations, and the final installation photographed beautifully while also standing up to heavy-use environments.

It’s rare to find a manufacturer that understands both the design intent and the operational side of project execution, but DecoScape has proven to be a valuable partner on multiple projects. I would absolutely recommend them to designers, procurement teams, and hospitality groups looking for dependable commercial outdoor furniture solutions.
reviews.owner_response: Thank you for your incredible feedback! We're proud to provide premium commercial outdoor furniture, custom design solutions, and exceptional service. Your trust and recommendation mean a great deal to the DecoScape LLC team. We look forward to collaborating on many more hospitality projects!

We were so happy to be able to buy a product “made in the USA”, and our residents are very happy.  Thanks Guys!!!

reviews.author: joe
reviews.text:
We recently purchased outdoor furniture from Deco Scape and had an amazing experience from start to finish. The quality of the furniture exceeded our expectations — beautiful, durable, and exactly what we were looking for to upgrade our outdoor space.

The delivery process was smooth, fast, and very professional. Everything arrived on time and in perfect condition, which made the entire experience stress-free and the prices were incredible.

The sales team was also outstanding. Everyone was friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about helping us find the right pieces without feeling pressured. They answered all of our questions and made the process enjoyable.

If you’re looking for high-quality outdoor furniture with excellent customer service and reliable delivery, I highly recommend Deco Scape!
reviews.owner_response: Thank you so much for your thoughtful review, Joe! We're thrilled that you had such a positive experience from start to finish. Knowing that our outdoor furniture, delivery, and customer service exceeded your expectations means everything to us. reviews.author: Dan Lowry
reviews.text: This company is SHADY. We got a price for some outdoor furniture directly from their sales team and another price from the company we use locally for outdoor projects. The price from the local company was literally twice the cost of the price directly from Decoscape. When I brought it up to the local company, they said they would look into. The next morning, I get an email from the Decoscape National Sales Manager saying that I was not an approved customer, so we never should have been sent the quote directly from Decoscape. No offer to honor the original quote. No new new quote. Just...nothing...
